tools.name: list_racc_categories
tools.description: List FDA Reference Amounts Customarily Consumed (RACC, 21 CFR 101.12) product categories used for Nutrition Facts serving sizes. Returns each category's id, group, name, reference amount and household measure hint. Optional filter words, e.g. 'cookie', 'carbonated beverage' or 'sauce'.

tools.name: search_label_ingredients
tools.description: Search the SKS nutrition ingredient library (about 3,600 records: USDA SR Legacy plus sourced calculations) for an ingredient's nutrients per 100 g, label declaration name and allergens. English or Chinese names. Each result says where its data comes from and which nutrients are missing.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_label_ingredients" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Search the SKS nutrition ingredient library (largely USDA-based) for an ingredient's nutrients per 100 g, label declaration name and allergens. findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
